summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and string-array indirection; when `bun` is not already present on the host, it downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle whose body is a large numeric string-array decoder over mangled globals. A commitlint config has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or for a bundled binary-style payload; the alternate-runtime execution path also evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code. The declared repository (`github.com/ornikar/shared-configs`) and package description (`📓 commitlint config`) do not match the shipped install-time behavior, consistent with a hijacked publisher or impersonation of Ornikar's shared configs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
